description: This file is a shell script that provides internationalization (i18n) support for the Git command-line interface by interfacing with gettext.sh or fallback methods, setting localization environment variables, and defining wrapper functions.

methods.name: eval_gettext
methods.description: A fallback method to translate text using gettext or its alternatives depending on the environment.

methods.name: gettextln
methods.description: Wrapper around gettext that appends a newline.

methods.name: eval_gettextln
methods.description: Evaluates gettext translation and appends a newline.
